spec.description: 广告页左下角跳过
Only tap the bottom Select Car tab from the verified Home tab state.
On S04, locate the target series row and click only the right-side 车型 button in that same row or card.
On S05, click only the exact target model year from the verified task, such as 2020款.
On S05_MODEL_YEAR_SELECTED, click only the exact target trim from the verified task. Similar or partial configuration names are forbidden.
On S05_TRIM_SELECTED, click only the explicit 确定 button once, then stop after read-only page recognition.
Use only after same-source count confirms more than one vehicle.
Use only after tap_sort_if_present in the multi-vehicle same-source result list.
Enter detail after price low-to-high sort has been verified.
